ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution; approximately 35-40% high-intensity white pixels localized to lateral lobes against 60-65% low-intensity black pixels concentrated in the central region and along the trailing edge.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white patches on the distal lateral sections of both lobes. Left lobe features a distinct isolated dark circular focal spot (approx. coordinate 0.22, 0.45 relative to fluke width). Right lobe features a distinctive curved dark linear mark resembling an arc (approx. coordinate 0.85, 0.48).

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated internal pixel angle of approximately 55 degrees; notch depth occupies roughly 15% of the total vertical fluke height visible.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge; pixel amplitude of peaks increases significantly towards the lateral tips, ranging from 5 to 15 pixels in height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge leading to pointed, slightly upturned lateral tips; leading edge (partially submerged) appears convex.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-contrast, textured light-brown and white pixel groups at the extreme distal tips of both lobes, consistent with localized barnacle colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions visible on the white surfaces; notable thin vertical scratch on the left lobe and a prominent horizontal-curved line on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense barnacle clusters on the outer terminal edges of both fluke lobes; various fine-line rake marks across the ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'smiley face' pareidolia pattern on the right lobe formed by a curved dark line and two small dark points above it.
